Hi Isabel / Kai —

Nice to meet you both on the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned:

- What I’m sending: attached is a short vendor DDQ template (vendor_ddq.xlsx) to capture any gaps quickly. If you prefer your own questionnaire, happy to take that instead.
- Access: we can provision a Trust Portal entry for MedivaTech where we’ll upload the report and any supporting artifacts. Typically we can get portal access to you within 24–48 hours once security is looped in.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm which questionnaire you want us to fill (attached DDQ or yours).
2) I’ll loop in our Security lead and PM for portal access and bridge letter upload.
3) Share any procurement deadline you have (you mentioned 6/14 on the call).

If it helps, I’ll provide a short summary of our GDPR/HIPAA posture in the portal too.

Thanks — I’ll wait for your preference on the questionnaire and confirmation of the deadline so I can prioritize this.

Best,

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

4) DDQ: We’ll populate the vendor_ddq.xlsx you provided; Marissa will own the questionnaire responses. Expect the completed DDQ and uploads within ~24 hours.

If MedivaTech needs additional evidence (config snapshots, policy excerpts), we can add them to the portal on request.

Schedule impact: target to have portal + report + bridge letter + completed DDQ available by 2027-06-08 EOD. If anything slips we’ll update the thread.

Best,
